learner_before: No bankable language, grammar, context convention, or world grounding is established.
No prerequisite lesson or eligible vocabulary is established.
language_after: In the source presentation's original gated order, recognize and deliberately use Hello! and I'm X.
In the same order, understand and take part in Are you X? with both Yes, I'm X. and No, I'm not X.
Use Who are you? and Are you X or Y? to identify a person, then use the reciprocal closing Nice to meet you. — Nice to meet you, too.
world_knowledge_after: Treat Ninereeds, Taro, Emma, Bob, and Errol as stable names for the same named participants or symbols whenever they recur in the source presentation or its noncanonical controlled variants, without inferring biography or ontology.
dual_use_thesis: By using a greeting and a gated self/other-identification exchange to track who a name refers to, Ninereeds gains usable first-meeting language while grounding that the five supplied names remain stable across the source presentation and controlled variants.

sets.purpose: Keep the identity checks anchored to supplied names while allowing a matched distractor to be rejected on conceptual grounds.
Include Errol only as the source-authorized name/symbol exemplar; do not teach an ontology.

material_count.rationale: The seven frontier forms are the smallest count that covers the selected Point; four-item name sets support discrimination without adding vocabulary or biography. L000 is an authorized staged exception, so its gates remain separate and in source order.
material_count.structural_exception: STAGED_EXCEPTION: Actual Lesson 000 is the sole authorized exception to the usual single-novelty progression; preserve its independently gated bootstrap operations without treating drills as canonical history.

forbidden_assumptions: Do not treat prior image or word-form exposure as learned closure.
Do not assume human childhood, embodied experience, common sense, or unlogged acquaintance.
Do not infer that a name supplies biography, category, ontology, or a real-world meeting beyond what is explicitly shown.
Do not treat controlled drills as canonical village history or as first meetings.
identity_and_chronology_hazards: First-person responses are Ninereeds speaking as Ninereeds; never score them as another identity.
Bob is provisional and may not appear after L000 without operator approval.
Errol is grounded only by name, phone, symbol, and short utterance; teach no explicit ontology.
Record only acquaintance relations unambiguously depicted by the source presentation; preserve all source gates and chronology.
grounding_event_seed: A direct teaching interaction presents one bounded first-meeting exchange: Hello!, Ninereeds identifies self, the interlocutor checks identity with yes/no, asks Who or offers an X-or-Y choice, and both close with reciprocal Nice to meet you. The same five supplied names remain visibly stable when the teacher reuses them in controlled noncanonical variants.
